name: Pozzik
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Pozzik tests goblin engineering against a gnome rival. Once among Undermine’s most respected engineers, he now builds experimental rocket cars on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Master of Undermine
sections.body: Pozzik made his name among goblin tinkerers before settling in Thousand Needles. He was one of Undermine’s most respected engineers, mastering complex internal combustion, propulsion, and dangerous chassis construction. He left that reputation behind for the salt flats, where he pushes high-speed machines to their limits.

sections.title: The Duel on the Salt Flats
sections.body: At the Mirage Raceway, Pozzik works with Fizzle Brassbolts, his longtime gnome counterpart. Goblin explosives and gnomish calibration have long stood as rivals, yet the two built a sprawling track across a dried lakebed. Now their racing outfits test prototype rocket cars to prove whose engineering rules the track. Pozzik seeks resourceful adventurers to find parts and lighten his designs.

faq.answer: Pozzik is a veteran goblin engineer from Undermine who now leads one side of the rocket car competition at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why is Pozzik out in Thousand Needles?
faq.answer: Pozzik left formal work in Undermine and came to the Shimmering Flats to build and race experimental rocket cars across the salt flats.

faq.q: What is his relationship with Fizzle Brassbolts?
faq.answer: Fizzle Brassbolts is Pozzik’s longtime gnomish rival and co-founder of the Mirage Raceway. They maintain the track together and compete to prove goblin engineering superior to gnomish craftsmanship.

faq.q: Does Pozzik work for the Horde or the Alliance?
faq.answer: Pozzik works independently at the raceway and does business with both Alliance and Horde travelers.

faq.q: What kind of projects is Pozzik working on right now?
faq.answer: Pozzik works to make his rocket cars faster. He develops multi-engine racing chassis, gathers rare lightweight ores, and sends explorers to recover salvaged parts and components.

angles.text: For goblin and gnomish engineers, Pozzik shows how far high-risk, high-speed mechanics can go.
At the track, gnomes meet their favorite foil in Pozzik, a loud goblin engineer who believes brute thrust beats careful precision.
